best_idea: Draw a unit's incoming damage as a darkened tail on its own health bar, computed from the same tick rule the engine uses, so the player reads what is about to be lost.
decision_why: The layered, pixel-snapped bar and the DOT tail are the idea we want, but Frankendom's HUD is client-only, so the numbers must come from the engine's own tick function; the donor's per-status predictors and dirty-flag cache would be a second ledger in the HUD. Donor defect (Poison predictor overshoots for fractional durations, 8 vs 7 for left 4.5) fixed in the sketch.
acceptance: In a duel against a bleeding or burning enemy, its health bar shows a darker segment at the right end equal to the damage the engine will still apply to it; a server test asserts the preview equals the sum of the engine's remaining tick damage for the same state, for one integer and one fractional duration.
